comment: Object Selection on the teapot photograph the module's suites use. The weights are put by hand into this checkout's shot profile, scratch/xdg/config/sara/data/module-data/background_removal/u2netp.pth, and the run keeps the profile so the tool opens no dialog. A drag shows the box, and its release runs the network on the box grown by a tenth and lays the mask inside the box, so the ants go round the teapot.
